summary.text: George Lavin is the Democratic candidate for Florida State Senate District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Ileana Garcia (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a legal consultant who was born in Miami.

paragraphs.text: George Lavin graduated from Christopher Columbus High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Florida International University in 1992, and received a law degree from the Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law in 1997.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Coral Gables, spent years in New York after graduate school, and returned to South Florida twenty years ago.
He said he works as a legal consultant.

Lavin said his campaign messages include the cost of property insurance, a tax system he described as regressive, and the state's decision not to accept federal funds to cover people in the health coverage gap.
He advanced from the canceled August 18, 2026 Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot.
